# NeumannCosine (neumann-cosine-lean) — version 0.1.0

Neumann cosine series on an interval [0, L] and the discrete Neumann Laplacian, in Lean 4 with Mathlib.
Lean v4.35.0, Mathlib v4.35.0. Namespace NeumannCosine. Apache-2.0. Author Le Chen.
Repository: https://github.com/chenle02/neumann-cosine-lean

The Lean declaration decides every hypothesis. Prose is not checked by Lean.
A receipt under .lean-receipts/ covers only the commit it names.

Headline declarations (most assume 0 < L):
- NeumannCosine.integral_mode_mul_mode: Gram values L, L/2, 0 of cos(kπx/L) on [0, L].
- NeumannCosine.KernelIntegrals.integral_cos_cos_cos_cos: closed form of the four-mode integral.
- NeumannCosine.ProductIdentities.cos_cos_cos_cos_lp: three ℓ¹ cosine series against a mode, as constrained sums.
- NeumannCosine.ProductIdentities.two_cosines_two_sines_lp: two ℓ¹ cosine series against two sines (n, k ≥ 1).
- NeumannCosine.Coefficients.summable_norm_cosineCoeff: NeumannW21 gives ℓ¹ cosine coefficients.
- NeumannCosine.Coefficients.hasSum_cosineCoeff: NeumannW21 gives the pointwise expansion on [0, L].
- NeumannCosine.Sobolev.WeakDerivative.ae_eq_const_of_integral_mul_deriv_eq_zero: du Bois-Reymond on (0, L).
- NeumannCosine.Sobolev.WeakDerivative.HasWeakDeriv.ae_eq_primitive: W^{1,1} gives an absolutely continuous representative.
- NeumannCosine.Sobolev.H2Neumann.H2.hasSum_cosineCoeff: H² with Neumann trace gives the expansion of a continuous representative.
- NeumannCosine.Discrete.Laplacian.reflectedNegLaplacian_cosine_eigenpair, discreteCosineMode_exhaustion: cosine eigenbasis of the reflected three-point stencil (L ≠ 0, N > 0).
- NeumannCosine.Discrete.Eigenvalues.discreteNeumannEigenvalue_tendsto: (4/h²) sin²(nπ/2N) → (nπ/L)².
- NeumannCosine.Discrete.ModalMinimumLimit.discreteModalMin_tendsto: discrete modal minimum → continuum infimum, for f continuous on (0, ∞) with K x ≤ f x, K > 0.

Not proved:
- No PDE existence, uniqueness or regularity theory; no semigroup.
- No L² completeness of the cosine system; no Parseval identity for general L² functions.
- No general bridge to Mathlib's fourierCoeff (only fourierCoeff_evenPeriodic for NeumannW21); planned for v0.2.
- One dimension only.

Build: lake exe cache get && lake build. Keep lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json unchanged; never run lake update in a verification run.
